instructions: Read every complete case in the paired workbook. The default is only a draft. Put a full Decision object in Override for every contradiction, then sign reviewedAllCases. The compiler refuses unsigned or candidate-less rows.

rows.Kwic: 敢問諸人，如何是現成公案？東澗水流西澗水，南山雲起北山雲。

Override.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Shishuang Erzhan (石霜爾瞻尊禪師語錄): in his eighth-day-of-the-twelfth-month hall address, Shishuang Dazun asks the assembly what the ready-made public case is and answers with water flowing east and west and clouds rising north and south.
